pin.longFormSummary:
A basic budget hotel and hostel hybrid near Munich’s Olympic Park, offering private family rooms, a shared guest kitchen and common spaces, with mixed guest reviews.

Family and budget stay

Choose a whole private family room and confirm its exact beds, occupancy and any cot requirements. An individual dorm bed is a different booking product. The hotel lists a shared guest kitchen and common spaces; breakfast and other extras should be checked in the booked rate.

The Landshuter Allee property sits by the Mittlerer Ring near the Olympic Park, away from the historic centre. Plan walking and public-transport routes, and compare the full private-room price including taxes, breakfast, parking and luggage storage.

Guest-review tradeoffs

The opened Tripadvisor snapshot rates the hotel 2.9/5 overall from 97 reviews. Some guests praise staff and nearby transport; others report cleanliness, room condition, heat and noise problems. Read recent feedback before choosing this basic stay, especially for children or summer travel. The category reflects accommodation type, not an assurance of high guest satisfaction.

Opening and conversion

The operator’s later opening chronology dates Munich Olympiapark to 25 March 2019.

The opening announcement describes conversion of a former office building into a hotel with 172 rooms and 822 beds. The current hotel page lists 172 rooms and 820 beds; the opening count and later listing are identified separately. No conversion-specific investment was verified.

MICHELIN complete Munich-and-surroundings directory 1–27 of 27 and Forbes Munich directory have no MEININGER match. AAA award program excludes Germany. Acclaim zero records checked-guide absence.

pin.longFormSummary:
A LEGO-themed family hotel at LEGOLAND New York in Goshen, with separate children’s sleeping areas, themed rooms and treasure hunts; check seasonal closures and recent reviews.

Family stay and packages

Choose Pirate, Kingdom, LEGO Friends or NINJAGO rooms and confirm your exact bed layout, occupancy and any cot requirements. The operator advertises separate children’s sleeping areas, treasure hunts, indoor play and family entertainment. Check scheduled activities and charges for arcade play.

Compare the full cost of your selected package: room, park tickets, breakfast, parking, taxes and cancellation terms. The advertised per-person package starting amount is not an all-in whole-room nightly quote.

Seasonal availability

On the seasonal-closures page read 22 November 2026, the hotel pool is listed as closed for the 2026 season. Several themed lands and areas are listed to close from 27 November 2026. The park operates seasonally: check the calendar, booking availability and attraction status for your actual travel dates.

Review tradeoffs

The opened Tripadvisor snapshot has an overall 3.1/5 from 89 reviews, with Value 2.5/5. Guests describe the appeal of themed rooms and walking to the park, alongside service, housekeeping, dining and extra-cost concerns. Read recent feedback before booking. This is a family-category option, not a budget recommendation.

My Cruising Family’s firsthand August 2021 stay describes the convenient walk to the park and its two-day package. That historical account is dated; its package price, food arrangements and cancellation terms are not presented as current offers.

Hotel opening and scale

The operator’s release issued 9 August 2021 records the hotel’s debut on 6 August and its 250 rooms. The hotel opening is separate from the earlier phased park opening and July 9 opening of all seven lands. No hotel-specific construction cost was verified; a wider resort investment is not allocated to the hotel.
